name: Next Level Education - Storytelling Video Agent (Claude)

flow.purpose: Writes the story: {narration, caption, video_theme} as strict JSON. See SKILL.md for the compliance rule this prompt encodes (no raw link/disclosure in the caption).
Parses module 1's JSON string output into narration/caption/video_theme fields.
Fetches a short-lived Azure Cognitive Services auth token for text-to-speech.
Calls Azure TTS with the narration text (SSML), Nigerian-English voice en-NG-EzinneNeural, returns MP3 audio bytes.
Uploads the narration MP3 to Google Drive so it has a fetchable URL.
Makes the uploaded MP3 publicly readable so the video-merge microservice can fetch it by URL.
Calls the user's own render microservice with a background clip URL (picked by keyword-matching video_theme+narration against clips c01-c19) and the narration audio URL; returns a merged MP4.
Posts the merged video to the Next Level Education Facebook Page. Caption has URLs and any disclosure/affiliate wording stripped - the disclosure lives in the comment instead (module 12).
Waits 90 seconds for Facebook to finish processing the video into a commentable post before the next step runs. Raise this if CreateComment keeps failing with 'object does not exist'.
Comments the disclosed affiliate link underneath the post.
